question:
Which of the following letter numeric clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete? 

JX 26, KY 31,?, PD47, TH58
solution:

The logic followed here is: 

First two letters → Increasing number series is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

Numbers → Odd number series is added to the given numeric series.
